page.overview:
Who is Clan Fuchs?

Clan Fuchs was one of the Clans in Mahakam. The founder of the clan was the famous Boros Fuchs, who died after an alcohol poisoning during one of the Mahakam Ale Festival. In glory days, Clan Fuchs territories used to stretch from Boro's Rump to Davor's Abyss.

Clan Fuchs had an age-old feud with Clan Zigrin who eventually seized the opportunity during one of the cruel blizzards and cut off Fuchses' escape, leaving them to die.
